reference_text:
Have you heard? Tavily is #1 on SealQA-Hard, SealQA-0, and SimpleQA.

 

We tested how Tavily Search ranks evidence, handles conflicting sources, and keeps its index fresh. The results put Tavily ahead of all other providers across all three benchmarks.

 

If you’re building agents, this is one worth watching.

Why does that matter? Your agents are only as reliable as the information they receive. Tavily surfaces stronger evidence, handles conflicting sources, and keeps results fresh, helping agents deliver answers you can trust.

 

The best part? These improvements are already live. That means no upgrades, new API versions, or changes on your end.

See the full results here
	
	
	

Tavily, 1350 Broadway, New York, New York 10018, United States
